The '''Workers memorials''' were placed around the [[Worker sector]] of [[New Apsolon (city)|New Apsolon]] to remember [[Workers|the Workers]] that had been [[Death/Legends|killed]] or arrested by [[Absolutes|the Absolutes]]. They were built after the [[Revolution on Apsolon|revolution]].

The memorial columns were made of [[Glass/Legends|glass]] and were lighted from the inside. A white light denoted the place where a person was killed by the Absolutes, a blue light a place where someone had been arrested.
